adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `update` simply re-renders `@embedding` and performs no persistence (it’s identical in effect to `show`). The client controller defines an action `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, so there is an intended save path even though the provided `embedding.hbs` template doesn’t invoke it. Also, the new specs for `Admin::EmbeddingController`/`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` only assert inheritance and do not exercise `show`/`update` responses to lock down the serialized payload shape (notably `EmbeddingSerializer` uses `has_many :embeddable_hosts, embed: :ids`, which the updated JS store hydration logic depends on). This is a concrete coverage/contract gap and potential design incompleteness, but not a directly verifiable broken behavior from this diff alone.
